messages:
sam: FYI — onboarded ceres-v2 (quantized) to staging at 09:30 PT. Ran evals vs prod-ceres1 on our spanish promptset; macro-F1 down ~3.2 pts. Short notes below, asking for quick triage.

oliver: Thanks — can you paste the top failing examples and the eval config?

sam: Eval config: `evals/run_cli --model ceres-v2 --ref prod-ceres1 --prompts spanish-core-2026`. Top diff example: ```json
{"prompt":"¿Cuál es la capital de Perú?","ref":"Lima","prod":"Lima","ceres-v2":"La capital es Lima."}
```
Metrics shift seems from small generation wording changes (punctuation/phrase expansion) rather than hallucinations.

maria: tagging @kai in case tokenizer changes caused token id shifts — ceres-v2 included a mergeset tweak last week. Also @ben for release guidance. :mag:

kai: I pulled the tokenizer diff — mergeset adds 12 merges, shouldn't affect base token ids but may change tokenization boundaries for short queries. I'll run token-diff: `scripts/token-diff.sh prod-ceres1 ceres-v2 spanish-core-2026` and post output in 15m.

ben: If this is just phrasing normalization hurting exact-match metrics, we should consider lenient scoring or normalizing references before rollback. But agree we need repro prompts before any canary widen. Can we do a 5% canary in prod routes while we fix metrics?

sam: blocker: I don't have a compact repro set for the worst regressions (need ~50 examples). Today: curate repro set + run A/B across canary 5% and staging full, then post charts. Pinged eng-releases for canary flag.

deploy-bot: Canary flag created: `redwood:ceres-v2:canary=5%` by sam (timestamp 6167891260).

chloe: Quick skim of the diffs I ran — most deltas are punctuation normalization and prefacing text (e.g., "La capital es"). That lowers exact-match and strict F1. Suggest adding a relaxed EM metric (token-level fuzzy) and normalizing references (lowercase, strip leading phrases) in eval harness.

maria: I'll add a metric wrapper and rerun with normalized refs; if gap drops below 1pt we can proceed. ETA EOD.

sam: Thanks — assigning: @maria rerun + metric wrapper, @oliver curate repro set and upload to eval bucket, @ben hold PR/release until we see A/B. I'll coordinate results here by EOD PT.

oliver: Noted — uploading repro to `/mnt/evals/ceres-v2/6167891234/repro_set.json` now. Will add a short README with steps to reproduce locally. :package:
